sonification.sound: S2 'minimal' (owner's pick, 2026-09-28): a soft low pulse at the value's pitch (MIDI 36-60, D minor pentatonic) with a soft filtered tick (4.5-7 kHz) at the start
sonification.mapping: pitch = bar value on one fixed scale for the film, snapped to the music key; lasts while the bar grows
sonification.timing: starts when the bar starts to grow (moved into the nearest syllable gap if the voice is sounding)

sonification.sound: S2: soft low pulses on eighth notes while the tip moves, pitch following the slope, each with a faint filtered tick
sonification.mapping: pitch follows the slope at the drawing tip (rising line = higher)
sonification.timing: while the tip moves; notes land in syllable gaps

sonification.sound: S2: one deeper pulse, pitch from the dot height, plus a soft filtered tick
sonification.mapping: pitch from the dot height on screen
sonification.timing: on the frame the dot appears (nearest syllable gap, -60..+120 ms)

sonification.sound: S2: a soft filtered tick per value change; above 8 changes/s the ticks merge into a soft roll

separation: Owner, 2026-09-28 (sổ gu G-006): the voice comes first; the data sounds must not cover it; never solved by raising the level.
Side-chain: the whole data layer ducks 8 dB while the voice is active (20 ms attack, 250 ms release).
Band: while the voice is active the data layer loses 1-4 kHz (the speech band) almost entirely.
Timing: notes that would start while a syllable sounds move to the quietest instant within -60..+120 ms.
Level: -16 dB under the voice before the side-chain (toolkit/audio/sonify_palettes.py); never raised.
